goal.objective: Improve GLLA's drafting-to-completion experience across all five remaining concerns: (1) use ask_user_question for structured drafting decisions when available, retaining prose for genuinely free-form questions or tool unavailability; (2) organize drafting into visible phases, batching independent questions and asking dependent questions after earlier answers; (3) diagnose and fix GLLA-owned unfinished drafting handoffs so a draft does not silently end after promising more questions, while preserving intentional waits for user input and preventing retry loops; (4) distinguish deliberate user pauses from supervised recovery/retry and actual monitoring, exposing truthful ownership and next action without claiming monitoring that does not exist; (5) make terminal summaries explain what changed and why it matters first, in readable groups, with compact verification and explicit limitations, moving detailed commands, hashes, and repository bookkeeping into the durable archive. Fix broken evidence-stripping fragments, duplicated approval/process text, oversized narrative tables, and loss of the whole-work recap after an audit-repair claim. Use the supplied GLLA, Deathrun, Neonbreak, drafting, and recovery screenshots as regression examples; do not merely truncate useful explanations or hide failed/skipped checks. Preserve full archival evidence, truthful verdicts, confirmation/ownership gates, lifecycle barriers, and archive-before-success. Implement and verify in GLLA on main, then release the next patch including the existing unreleased paragraph and audit fixes and verify publication. Exclude note.md Later/Research, unrelated improvements, modifications to Pi core or other plugins/projects, and new speculative queue work. If a reported symptom is external-only, document the evidence and provide only safe GLLA-owned containment rather than expanding scope.

Fix broken evidence-stripping fragments, duplicated approval/process text, oversized narrative tables, and loss of the whole-work recap after an audit-repair claim. Use the supplied GLLA, Deathrun, Neonbreak, drafting, and recovery screenshots as regression examples; do not merely truncate useful explanations or hide failed/skipped checks. Preserve full archival evidence, truthful verdicts, confirmation/ownership gates, lifecycle barriers, and archive-before-success. Implement and verify in GLLA on main, then release the next patch including the existing unreleased paragraph and audit fixes and verify publication. Exclude note.md Later/Research, unrelated improvements, modifications to Pi core or other plugins/projects, and new speculative queue work. If a reported symptom is external-only, document the evidence and provide only safe GLLA-owned containment rather than expanding scope.
Done when:
1. A checked-in requirement-to-evidence report maps all five concerns and supplied screenshots to implemented behavior or an evidence-backed external-only disposition; note.md Next entries are reconciled without deleting unrelated notes.
2. Behavioral drafting tests pass for structured picker use/guidance, phased dependent questions, answer-to-next-question/proposal handoff, tool-unavailable/free-form fallback, and intentional waiting without autonomous retry loops.
3. Behavioral display/lifecycle tests pass for deliberate pause, automatic recovery/retry, auditing, and supported monitoring states; labels expose truthful ownership/next action without changing durable lifecycle or consent semantics.
4. Production-renderer fixtures based on the supplied completion examples verify outcome-first grouped explanations, compact truthful verification, visible failures/skips/limitations, no broken stripping fragments or duplicate approval noise, complete archival evidence, and whole-work recap preservation across audit-repair claims. Save and inspect representative rendered output.
5. Bounded verification passes with TMPDIR=/var/tmp: npm run release:check (full suite, typecheck, package smoke) and git diff --check; retain raw results and disclose skips rather than claiming they ran.
6. The next patch version, changelog, and release metadata include these changes plus existing Unreleased work; tag/release and published npm version are verified, with committed evidence on main and no history rewriting.

Fix broken evidence-stripping fragments, duplicated approval/process text, oversized narrative tables, and loss of the whole-work recap after an audit-repair claim. Preserve full archival evidence, truthful verdicts, confirmation/ownership gates, lifecycle barriers, and archive-before-success. Implement and verify in GLLA on main, then release the next patch including the existing unreleased paragraph and audit fixes and verify publication. Exclude note.md Later/Research, unrelated improvements, modifications to Pi core or other plugins/projects, and new speculative queue work. If a reported symptom is external-only, document the evidence and provide only safe GLLA-owned containment rather than expanding scope.

objectiveProvenance.originalObjective: Improve GLLA's drafting-to-completion experience across all five remaining concerns: (1) use ask_user_question for structured drafting decisions when available, retaining prose for genuinely free-form questions or tool unavailability; (2) organize drafting into visible phases, batching independent questions and asking dependent questions after earlier answers; (3) diagnose and fix GLLA-owned unfinished drafting handoffs so a draft does not silently end after promising more questions, while preserving intentional waits for user input and preventing retry loops; (4) distinguish deliberate user pauses from supervised recovery/retry and actual monitoring, exposing truthful ownership and next action without claiming monitoring that does not exist; (5) make terminal summaries explain what changed and why it matters first, in readable groups, with compact verification and explicit limitations, moving detailed commands, hashes, and repository bookkeeping into the durable archive. Fix broken evidence-stripping fragments, duplicated approval/process text, oversized narrative tables, and loss of the whole-work recap after an audit-repair claim. Use the supplied GLLA, Deathrun, Neonbreak, drafting, and recovery screenshots as regression examples; do not merely truncate useful explanations or hide failed/skipped checks. Preserve full archival evidence, truthful verdicts, confirmation/ownership gates, lifecycle barriers, and archive-before-success. Implement and verify in GLLA on main, then release the next patch including the existing unreleased paragraph and audit fixes and verify publication. Exclude note.md Later/Research, unrelated improvements, modifications to Pi core or other plugins/projects, and new speculative queue work. If a reported symptom is external-only, document the evidence and provide only safe GLLA-owned containment rather than expanding scope.
